t: You're looking at the statue of Admiral Lord Nelson, standing on top of Nelson's Column. Horatio Nelson was a Royal Navy officer, remembered for his leadership, his grasp of strategy and his unconventional tactics, which brought several decisive British naval victories during the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. Many regard him as the greatest admiral in history. The figure was carved by Edward Hodges Baily, a prolific English sculptor who made many public monuments and statues, including work for Marble Arch and Buckingham Palace, and several memorials in St Paul's Cathedral.
